messages:
alex: Finished deploy to eu-west at 14:02 UTC. Running post-deploy checks now — noticing the tokenization synthetic is under-covering on canary (coverage dropped ~30% vs baseline).

maya: saw the alert too. Which probe exactly? token-sanity or end-to-end/context-alignment?

alex: token-sanity. It’s the small prefix probe we run (100 sample set). Fail rate up, p95 latency unchanged. No obvious 503s.

jon: deploy-bot posted canary status earlier: canary=12 nodes, rollout=10%, variant=v2.4.0. No autoscale events.

deploy-bot: Deploy summary: inference-api v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0, canary_nodes=12, rollout_pct=10, health=rolling.

kevin: uploading the quick trace from the failing synthetic: `curl -sS https://telemetry/reports/5901112222/token-sanity.json` (short log snippet below)
```
[token-sanity] sample 42: tokenizer returned 0 tokens for input with punctuation
[token-sanity] sample 73: unexpected BOS token sequence length=0
[token-sanity] anomaly_rate: 0.31
```

maya: weird — tokenizer changes landed in this release (small patch to preserve trailing punctuation). Could be a regression in the tokenizer fallback path.

alex: options I see: 1) hold rollout at 10% and pin canary to previous model binary (rollback just on canary nodes), 2) rollback full rollout, 3) hotfix patch and re-deploy. Thoughts? Need quick decision because this probe is part of our preflight for embeddings downstream.

sre-bot: Observability: kv-cache miss spike correlated with canary start? small bump at +2m, not sustained. No host OOMs. CPU/gpu utilization steady.

jon: if kv-cache miss is transient, and p95 latency is stable, my vote is to hold rollout at 10% and pin canary to v2.3.1 for now (rollback on canary only). That buys time to triage tokenizer without impacting global traffic.

kevin: I can run a quick binary swap on the canary pool — flip 12 nodes back to v2.3.1 and keep the rest of the rollout paused. ETA ~6m.

alex: agreed. kevin, do the binary swap. Maya + Jon, start triage on tokenizer diffs and run the full sample suite against v2.4.0 locally. I’ll update release notes with a note about the hold.

deploy-bot: Action queued: partial rollback (canary nodes) -> target=12 nodes, target_version=v2.3.1, initiated_by=kevin. Will post status updates.

kevin: swap started. `kubectl set image deployment/inference-canary inference=redwood/inference:v2.3.1 --record`

deploy-bot: Partial rollback succeeded. canary_nodes=12 now running v2.3.1. rollout_pct remains 10% (paused).

alex: thanks — holding rollout and tagging release: v2.4.0 paused due to tokenizer regression. I'll create a follow-up thread for the triage. If token-sanity passes after fix, we can resume canary then continue gradual rollout. :thumbsup:

maya: noted. saving failing samples to /tmp/token-sanity-fails-5901112222.json and sharing in the triage thread.

jon: adding a quick smoke-test that exercises punctuation-heavy inputs to the regression suite.

kevin: done. rolling back canary gave us breathing room, good call.

alex: closing this thread for deploy ops — triage thread: 5901113000-tokenizer-regression-triage (incoming).
